craft_notes: Sthāyin: interior mechanism. Sanskrit-first: manasā kept as the means-word. Rows: 2. Close: his going. Rejected: naming the soul masculine — killed: vihīnāṃ feminine kept. Read aloud: inward cadence — treads, wakes.

lines: Mind he treads the path, far-shore-knowing;
birth-loosed soul, wake — by his going.
l4.sanskrit_cite: adhvānaṃ manasā dhyātvā dīkṣayettattvapāragaḥ | jananādivihīnāṃ tu yena yenādhvanā guruḥ
